source_contract.startup: Existing early inhibit/profile preparation and retained SRAM false path unchanged; service initialization performs no charger I/O
source_contract.commands: wf_charger status | stop | start <1..60 seconds>; start/stop enqueue, no shell-thread device I/O
source_contract.ownership: Single wf_charge worker owns session/charger writes/diagnostics; snapshot and command flags copied in short IRQ critical sections
source_contract.profile: Nominal 4170mV/80mA, not measured limits; no reset commands or automatic re-enable
source_contract.entry: Fresh preparation/readbacks, ID, CEB, watchdog, normal termination/safety timer, PG and fault checks; fresh ADC 3500..4100mV is only an experiment admission rule
source_contract.monitor: One-second RTOS event wait while enabled; inactive waits forever. Checks cancel/deadline around each operation and again after bus lock before enable
source_contract.exit: Manual, timeout, input loss, profile drift, fault, regulation, voltage failure/guard or chip completion attempts inhibition; only fresh CEB=1 readback reports inhibited
source_contract.unconfirmed: Stop failure retains IDLE, blocks start and has no autonomous retry; explicit stop may retry. Persistent failed communication may retain IDLE indefinitely
source_contract.io: 50ms bounded outer recursive bus mutex acquisition; SDK 5s transfer timeout and BUSY/recovery behavior retained. No hard physical stop deadline claimed
source_contract.adc: Shared project mutex covers open/enable/read/disable/close, 100ms acquisition; initialized before either worker starts
source_contract.faults: REG08 watchdog and REG09[5:0] masks; REG09[7:6] shipping configuration ignored as fault. First observed fault rejects same start; read can clear exited fault latch
source_contract.status: Cached timestamp/validity plus asynchronous inactive raw dump; active status wakes existing monitor and may therefore advance a stop
